lightning__root.title: Lightning Bolt
lightning__root.description: Unlocks Lightning Bolt (Level 3) (76 mana, 35.62 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__root.extra_description: Down from the heavens, summon a bolt of lightning. The first skill of the Lightning base.

lightning__lightning_field.title: Lightning Field
lightning__lightning_field.description: Unlocks Lightning Field (Level 3) (65 mana, 42.75 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__lightning_field.extra_description: Creates an electricity field that electrocutes the ground and deals continuous damage to enemies.

lightning__lightning_spark.title: Lightning Spark
lightning__lightning_spark.description: Unlocks Lightning Spark (Level 3) (10 mana, 2.85 s cooldown) on the ability wheel

lightning__ball_lightning.title: Ball Lightning
lightning__ball_lightning.description: Unlocks Ball Lightning (Level 3) (20 mana, 2.85 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__ball_lightning.extra_description: Conjure an orb of lightning that slowly moves forward, damaging creatures it phases through and bouncing off blocks.

lightning__planned_storm_hounds.title: Storm Hounds
lightning__planned_storm_hounds.description: Unlocks Storm Hounds (55 mana, 120 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__planned_storm_hounds.extra_description: Summon wolves wreathed in lightning whose bites chain a spark to a nearby enemy.

lightning__hypervitality.title: Hyper Vitality
lightning__hypervitality.description: Teaches Hyper Vitality, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Innate skills use stamina when your weapon charge is not full. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

lightning__constitution_1.title: Constitution 1
lightning__constitution_1.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

lightning__constitution_mastery_i.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

lightning__lightning_strike.description: Unlocks Lightning Strike (Level 3) (36 mana, 21.38 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__lightning_strike.extra_description: Summons a lightning strike and electrocutes the target.

lightning__ascension.title: Ascension
lightning__ascension.description: Unlocks Ascension (Level 3) (37 mana, 21.38 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__ascension.extra_description: Cast to strike lightning at your feet and ascend quickly into the air, and gain reduced gravity for a short duration. The lightning bolt deals damage and knocks back creatures struck.

lightning__lightning_dance.title: Lightning Dance
lightning__lightning_dance.description: Unlocks Lightning Dance (Level 3) (50 mana, 28.5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__lightning_dance.extra_description: Launches multiple lightning spears at nearby targets.

lightning__planned_thunder_step.title: Thunder Step
lightning__planned_thunder_step.description: Unlocks Thunder Step (30 mana, 12 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__planned_thunder_step.extra_description: Teleport up to 14 blocks where you look in a flash of lightning; enemies near where you leave and where you land are shocked and staggered.

lightning__reservoir_2.extra_description: Core bonus (every archetype has this spoke).

lightning__lightning_lance.title: Lightning Lance
lightning__lightning_lance.description: Unlocks Lightning Lance (Level 3) (50 mana, 11.4 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__lightning_lance.extra_description: Hold to charge a spear made of lightning. Release to throw it like a javelin, dealing high damage to the creature it hits.

lightning__thunderstorm.title: Thunderstorm
lightning__thunderstorm.description: Unlocks Thunderstorm (Level 3) (65 mana, 114 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__thunderstorm.extra_description: Cast to conjure a thunderstorm centered around yourself, which strikes nearby creatures within sight with a small bolt of lightning every 2 seconds for the spell's duration.

lightning__shockwave.title: Shockwave
lightning__shockwave.description: Unlocks Shockwave (Level 3) (58 mana, 42.75 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__shockwave.extra_description: Coalesce a surge of electrical power, and unleash it in a devastating shockwave, blasting exposed creatures.

lightning__lightning_spear.title: Lightning Spear
lightning__lightning_spear.description: Unlocks Lightning Spear (Level 3) (36 mana, 7.12 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__lightning_spear.extra_description: Throws a summoned lightning spear projectile that deals damage.

lightning__lightning_ball.title: Lightning Ball
lightning__lightning_ball.description: Unlocks Lightning Ball (Level 3) (65 mana, 35.62 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__lightning_ball.extra_description: Throws a lightning ball that deals area damage.

lightning__lightning_swarm.title: Lightning Swarm
lightning__lightning_swarm.description: Unlocks Lightning Swarm (Level 3) (58 mana, 28.5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__lightning_swarm.extra_description: Releases a swarm of electric sparks against multiple targets.

lightning__electrocute.title: Electrocute
lightning__electrocute.description: Unlocks Electrocute (Level 3) (4 mana, 17.1 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__electrocute.extra_description: Hold to manifest a cone of electrical energy, damaging creatures in its path.

lightning__reserve_mana.title: Reserve Mana
lightning__reserve_mana.description: Teaches Reserve Mana, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Refills your mana at once when it drops below 10%. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

lightning__rapid_chant.title: Rapid Chant
lightning__rapid_chant.description: Teaches Rapid Chant, an Epic Fight Passive skill: Much shorter cast times, and channelled spells last much longer. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen

lightning__chain_lightning.extra_description: Start a chain of lightning from a targeted creature, causing waves of zapping magic to cascade to nearby creatures

lightning__blood_step.description: Unlocks Blood Step (Level 3) (36 mana, 17.1 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__blood_step.extra_description: Instantaneously teleport to where you are looking, or directly behind any targeted creature. Gain a short duration of true invisibility upon reaching your destination.

lightning__megido.title: Electric Rain
lightning__megido.description: Unlocks Electric Rain (Level 3) (28 mana, 28.5 s cooldown) on the ability wheel
lightning__megido.extra_description: Summon the wrath of the heavens, striking with lightnings every entity that dares to come around.

lightning__hasty_casting.title: Hasty Casting
lightning__hasty_casting.description: Teaches Hasty Casting, an Epic Fight Mobility skill: Spells take half as long to cast, and much faster movement while casting. Equip it in the Combat Skills box of the abilities screen
